name: return_without_effect
description: Returns immediately with no body, so the routine has no effect.

name: set_pursuit_target_and_timer
description: Stores the second object pointer as the target, sets the direction word to 1 or minus 1 by comparing the two horizontal positions, moves the vertical position up by eight units, and loads two timers with 50 and 10.

name: step_toward_target_horizontally
description: Returns to the pursuit setup when the horizontal gap exceeds 56; otherwise it shifts a saved position word, steps both the object and its target 10 units toward each other horizontally, and calls a subroutine before setting a timer to 4.

name: select_actor_state_from_flags
description: Chooses a new actor state from two flags in the game globals: when the first flag is clear it adopts a pending state and polls up to 24 frames, and when it is set it selects state 15 or 20 depending on a second flag.

name: clear_pending_target_on_miss
description: When the preceding test fails it clears the byte at the output pointer, runs two subroutines, resets the state word to zero and returns minus one; otherwise it returns the test result unchanged.

name: check_stored_point_proximity
description: Returns without action unless the vertical position is zero; when a global flag and a stored point are set, it returns early if the object lies within the tolerance of that point on both axes.

name: test_point_inside_tolerance_box
description: Returns early when the supplied coordinate pair lies within the tolerance box of a stored object position, and otherwise leaves the state unchanged.

name: check_alternate_point_proximity
description: Like the stored-point check, but gated by two flags and tested against a second stored point, returning early when the object is within tolerance on both axes.

name: test_point_inside_secondary_box
description: Returns early when the supplied coordinate pair lies within the tolerance box of a second stored position, which is only tested when two flag bytes are set.

name: scan_hazard_table_for_contact
description: When a global flag is set, scans a table of up to four coordinate pairs and returns minus one for the first pair within tolerance on both axes, or zero when none match.

name: scan_pointer_table_for_contact
description: Scans a table of up to four coordinate pairs held behind a record pointer, returning minus one for the first pair within the record's tolerances on both axes, or zero when none match.

name: check_fixed_rectangle_contact
description: When a flag is set and the timer word is above 16, tests whether the object's horizontal position, offset by 24, lies within 5 units and its vertical position within 10 units of a stored point, returning early on contact.

name: check_rectangle_contact_at_pointer
description: Does the same rectangle contact test as the fixed-rectangle check, but reads its flag, timer and stored point from a record pointer supplied by the caller.

name: enter_state_six_clearing_flag
description: Unless the current state is 4 or 5, records the pointer, sets the timer to 84 and moves the actor to state 6; in every case it writes minus one to a byte of the record.

name: check_flagged_point_proximity
description: When a flag at the object is set, tests whether the object lies within the tolerances of a second stored point, returning early on a match.

name: check_record_point_within_box
description: When the flag byte of the record is set, returns early if the supplied point lies within the record's stored box on both axes.

name: run_actor_state_machine_step
description: Counts down a delay timer and, once it reaches zero, dispatches on the current action code to branches that set a follow-up timer and move the actor to state 7, returning a value from the chosen branch.

name: dispatch_optional_indirect_handler
description: Calls a routine through the pointer in the address register, then calls a second routine through a pointer when the zero flag is set.

name: check_record_ahead_within_range
description: Returns minus one when the flagged record has a smaller vertical value than the actor and lies within 33 units horizontally, and zero otherwise.

name: check_record_offset_band_contact
description: Returns minus one when the flagged record is at or beyond the actor vertically and its horizontal offset, adjusted by a direction bit, lies between 32 and 64 units; otherwise zero.

name: check_record_level_contact_band
description: Returns minus one when the flagged record sits at the same vertical value as the actor and its horizontal offset, adjusted by a direction bit, is under 65 units; otherwise zero.

name: check_record_level_contact_wide
description: Runs only while a global pointer is clear, then applies the level contact test with a wider horizontal limit of 129 units and returns minus one on a hit.

name: enter_state_eight_by_action
description: In state 13 it checks whether a tracked point lies within 12 units on both axes and updates a facing bit; otherwise, when a counter condition holds, it sets state 8 for a fixed set of action codes.

name: write_map_cell_when_aligned
description: Counts down a timer and, once it has expired and the vertical position is aligned to a 16-unit grid, computes the grid cell from the position and stores the actor's code byte into that cell.

name: update_direction_from_neighbour_cells
description: Sets a direction byte from the action code and from a vertical comparison with a stored value, then probes neighbouring grid cells in turn and returns the last probed value.

name: apply_requested_direction_state
description: Checks a two-bit requested direction against the current and opposite stored directions and, when it is new, sets the matching direction code, state timer and movement bit, returning the probe result.

name: apply_requested_direction_only
description: Applies a two-bit requested direction in the same way as the direction-state routine but without comparing against the current direction, setting the direction code, timer and movement bit when the probe succeeds.

name: choose_direction_toward_target
description: Compares the target's horizontal position with the actor's, chooses a direction value of 0, 1 or 2 according to the action code, and when that direction is new, probes it and stores it with a timer of 4.

name: choose_vertical_direction_from_record
description: Compares the actor's vertical position with a record's and, when the horizontal gap exceeds 15 units, probes a direction and stores it with a timer of 4.

name: check_global_point_proximity_band
description: When the vertical position is zero and a global flag is set, returns early if the object lies within 64 units horizontally of a global point and its vertical distance to that point is no more than the horizontal offset.

name: check_record_proximity_band
description: Returns early when the record's flag is set and the point lies within 64 units horizontally, with a vertical distance no larger than that horizontal offset.

name: set_facing_bit_from_position
description: Clears the low bit of a flags byte, then sets it when the actor's horizontal position is less than the value returned by a subroutine.

name: set_facing_bit_from_sign
description: Clears the low bit of a flags byte and sets it again when a called routine returns a negative value.

name: read_global_word_value
description: Returns a 16-bit word stored at a fixed offset in the global game record, with no other processing.

name: clamp_horizontal_position
description: Clamps the horizontal position to the range 8 to 248 by snapping it to the nearer limit whenever it falls outside that range.

name: collect_grid_cell_bit
description: Converts the actor's position to a grid cell and, if that cell's bit is set in a bitmask table, clears it, nudges the actor onto the cell, bumps a capped counter on its record and decrements a global remaining count, calling a routine at zero.

name: collect_grid_bit_from_argument
description: Performs the same grid-cell bit clear and remaining-count update as the position-based routine, but takes the cell column from the argument register instead of the position.

name: return_without_effect
description: Returns immediately with no body, so the routine has no effect.

name: snap_to_fixed_contact_point
description: Clears a flag byte and, when the subroutine result is zero and a global contact point exists, snaps the vertical position to that point minus 28 if the actor is inside the contact window, setting the flag and returning minus one.

name: snap_to_record_contact_point
description: Performs the same snap-to-contact-point test as the fixed-point routine, but takes the contact point from a record pointer supplied by the caller.

name: copy_position_into_new_record
description: When the argument is nonzero, copies the actor's horizontal and vertical positions into a new record, stores the argument in it, adds the argument to a counter in the owner record and returns minus one; otherwise it returns zero.

name: pause_state_and_sync_position
description: Saves the current state, sets state 18 and polls up to 24 frames for a linked record's movement value, copying that record's position into the actor when found, then restores the saved state and moves the vertical position up by one.

name: insert_rounded_block_into_list
description: Rounds a block size up to a multiple of eight and links the block into a size-ordered list, updating a count before and after the insertion when the size and pointer are nonzero.

name: count_down_return_field_difference
description: Counts a loop down from the argument, calling a routine on each pass, then returns the difference between a word in the actor record and a word held at a pointer the record references.

name: update_record_position_toggle_bit
description: Copies the actor's position into its record, counts down a record timer, toggles the bit-two movement flag on a pattern chosen from the timer's high bits, and stores the vertical position in a field when a flag is clear.

name: update_actor_movement_and_collision
description: Clears a state bit and enters state 18 when a movement-cancel flag is set; otherwise advances the actor horizontally by 32 units when the tile bitmap around its position allows, updating its record and calling collision routines.

name: read_record_word_alignment_check
description: Reads a word from the record and returns it, after a row-alignment and horizontal distance check whose outcome does not change the returned value.

name: check_same_row_proximity
description: Returns early without effect; it tests whether the given vertical value matches the actor's and its horizontal offset is under 9 units, and does nothing in either outcome.

name: step_actor_horizontally_by_two
description: Moves the actor two units left or right according to bit zero of its flags, counts down a record counter when it passes the edge limit, and stores the vertical position in a field when a global flag is clear.

name: run_subroutine_in_state_18
description: Saves the actor's state word, sets it to 18, calls two subroutines, then restores the saved state.

name: probe_offset_table_for_path
description: On first entry marks the record active and tries up to four offset pairs from a table, placing the record at each candidate position and calling routines until one succeeds, then toggles a direction bit and clears the active flag.

name: probe_offset_table_for_path
description: Performs the same offset-table probe as the preceding routine; it is a duplicate copy of the same code with identical behaviour.

name: check_flag_without_effect
description: Tests a flag byte in the actor record and returns without changing anything in either outcome.

name: apply_direction_bits_to_velocity
description: Reads direction bits from the input word and, depending on those bits, adds or subtracts the stored velocity step to the position, sets a movement code in the actor record and calls handlers.

name: advance_vertical_position_by_velocity
description: Sets the action codes to 4 and 10, adds the stored velocity step to the vertical position, sets the movement flag, and clears it again when bit three of the adjusted position is set.

name: queue_text_draw_request
description: Queues a text-drawing request with two-byte parameters, choosing between two text strings by comparing a score word with 40 and by a mode flag, with the interrupt-enable register written around the update.

name: queue_text_draw_at_offset
description: Queues a text-drawing request two units below a stored vertical value, sets its mode to 1 or 0 depending on a flag, and sends it only when the output flag is clear.

name: queue_record_text_draw_request
description: Queues a fixed label string for drawing two units below the record's vertical value, sending it only when the record's mode byte is clear.

name: format_value_into_text_buffer
description: When the output flag and a second flag are clear, fills a text buffer with spaces, writes up to six copies of a fill character derived from a stored value, and queues the buffer for drawing four units below the stored position.

name: format_record_count_text
description: When the output flag and a record flag are clear, fills a text buffer with spaces, repeats a fill character up to six times using a count from the record, and queues the buffer for drawing four units below the record's vertical position.

name: format_bit_flags_into_text
description: Converts the four low bits of a flag byte into a four-character text buffer, using a space for each clear bit, then queues the buffer for drawing six units below the stored position when the output flag is clear.

name: format_record_bits_into_text
description: Converts four bits from a record byte into a text buffer, with a space for each clear bit, and queues it for drawing six units below the record's vertical position.

name: queue_paused_label_text
description: Queues a fixed label string for drawing at a constant vertical position in mode zero, with the output counter and the interrupt-enable register updated around the call.

name: queue_text_request_offset_two
description: Queues a text request in mode zero at a position two units below the stored vertical value, updating the output counter around the call.

name: clear_record_counter_word
description: Writes zero to a 16-bit word inside the data block that a pointer field of the actor references.

name: clear_two_record_flag_bytes
description: Writes zero to two adjacent flag bytes inside the actor record.

name: arm_record_when_enabled
description: When an enabling flag is set, computes a timing value from a global word and a record field, stores it in the record, and sets one of two record flags depending on whether the referenced data's first byte equals 4.

name: set_record_flag_twelve
description: Sets the byte at offset 12 of the record to minus one and has no other effect.

name: decode_run_length_stream
description: Returns the next symbol from a run-length stream when the first flag is set, appends the current symbol and increments its repeat count when the second flag is set, and otherwise returns the leading word of the referenced data.

name: return_without_effect
description: Returns immediately with no body, so the routine has no effect.

name: lookup_indexed_table_entry
description: Derives an index from two five-bit fields packed in the input, selects a table pointer from a global table, and returns the indexed entry, or the packed input when that pointer is zero.

name: call_when_self_linked
description: Calls a subroutine only when the record's pointer at offset 12 points back to the record itself.

name: clone_record_and_shift_bitplane
description: Copies the source record into a new record and links the two, then fills the new record's bitplane rows by shifting each 16-bit word of the source rows by a bit offset from the record and passing each byte through a lookup table.

name: shift_bitplane_rows_by_offset
description: Shifts 16-bit words of the source rows by a bit offset taken from the record, passing each byte through a lookup table and writing the results into the destination rows backward from the last word.

name: read_joystick_direction_fire_bits
description: Decodes the two joystick port data registers into direction bits and a fire-button bit, storing each port's bits in its own state word.

name: save_registers_and_toggle_flag
description: Copies the processor data and address registers into fixed memory cells, calls two subroutines, sets, inverts or clears a flag byte depending on two conditions, and decrements a counter.

name: stub_trap_zero_gap
description: Issues trap number zero and returns; it lies in an unreached region, so it is not game logic.

name: count_frame_after_call
description: Calls a subroutine and then increments a 32-bit counter stored in the global record.

name: install_level_three_interrupt_handler
description: Writes a routine's address into the level-three interrupt vector slot, sets the global interrupt control word, and stores a long word from the low vector table into the global record.

name: dispatch_audio_command_code
description: Handles a pending command word: when a flag and a second condition hold it resets several state fields, and otherwise it dispatches the command code, clearing the four audio volume registers for one code, toggling a byte for another, and updating flags for the rest.

name: process_tile_grid_cells
description: When two list pointers differ, walks a grid of 14 rows by 16 columns and calls a per-cell routine with each cell's index and an incrementing counter.

name: process_tile_grid_from_base
description: Walks the same 14 by 16 grid starting from the pointer passed in the argument register, calling the per-cell routine for each cell with an incrementing counter.

name: run_four_steps_nesting_counter
description: Increments a nesting counter, calls four subroutines in turn, decrements the counter, and restores the global interrupt control word when it reaches zero.

name: call_if_table_bit_set
description: Selects a table entry from the low four bits of a counter word and calls a routine only when the bit named by that entry is set in a bitmask table.

name: run_steps_with_optional_pair
description: Increments a nesting counter, always calls one routine and calls a second pair when a flag byte is set, then decrements the counter and restores the global control word at zero.

name: append_six_byte_command_record
description: Writes a six-byte record made of the constants 1025 and 32, the argument and zero into the output list, then advances the list pointer by six.

name: run_four_subroutines
description: Calls four subroutines in sequence with no other work of its own.

name: run_four_subroutines
description: Calls four subroutines in sequence with no other work of its own.

name: append_clipped_sprite_record
description: Clips a rectangle against horizontal limits, computes two edge offsets, appends a sprite entry with the clipped position to the output list, and calls four subroutines.

name: program_blitter_registers
description: Waits until the blitter is free, then writes the mask, source and destination registers and the blitter size from the supplied values.

name: flush_linked_entry_list
description: Walks a linked list of entries, calling three subroutines for each entry, then empties the list by clearing its first link and pointing the list head at it.

name: emit_text_buffer_glyphs
description: Clears a pending-blank flag bit, optionally blanks the first buffer cell, then emits the buffer's paired glyph codes, advancing the column counter by two with wrap-around of the column and row counters.

name: emit_text_glyph_pairs
description: Walks a zero-terminated buffer of glyph pairs, emitting each glyph through a subroutine, and advances the text cursor after each pair.

name: advance_text_cursor
description: Advances the text column by two and, after column seven, resets the column and moves the row forward, wrapping the row after 27.

name: blend_glyph_into_bitplanes
description: Combines eight pairs of 16-bit glyph columns into two bitplanes, using a table indexed by two character codes and a running XOR-blend mask, and writes the results into the destination buffer.

name: emit_ascii_digit_by_division
description: Derives one decimal digit by counting repeated subtractions of the divisor, converts it to an ASCII character, and stores it when the sign test passes.

name: emit_digit_blank_leading_zero
description: Derives one decimal digit by repeated subtraction, writes a space instead of a leading zero when the suppress flag is set, and stores the character when the width counter is positive.

name: advance_eight_step_counter
description: Advances a counter modulo eight while it is non-negative, and calls two subroutines each time it wraps to zero.

name: rotate_six_word_buffer
description: Saves the first word, shifts the following words down by one place across a six-word buffer, and stores the saved word in the last place.

name: lookup_and_store_table_value
description: Returns the input unchanged when a flag is set; otherwise, for an index below 14, looks up a long word from a table, passes it to a subroutine, and links a non-null result into the record, returning 100 for out-of-range indices.

name: clear_list_entry_record_field
description: Zeroes a field in the record the entry points to, clears the entry's first two words, and copies its third word into a global.

name: claim_earliest_channel_slot
description: Chooses between two stored timing slots for the requested index, picks the one with the smaller key, and when that key is not after the requested time, claims it by storing the time and value and clearing the linked record.

name: claim_earliest_slot_into_record
description: Picks the earlier of two stored timing slots and, when its key is not after the requested time, claims it by copying two words into the caller's record and storing the new time and value.

name: claim_second_pair_slot
description: Performs the same claim operation as the preceding routine, applied to a different pair of stored timing slots.

name: update_stored_word_when_changed
description: Stores the argument word and runs a subroutine inside a nesting-counter bracket only when it differs from the previously stored word.

name: initialize_channel_state_block
description: Sets the initial counters and a set of default parameter words for a channel block, including a table pointer and a starting mode, after calling three setup subroutines.

name: initialize_channel_state_block
description: Performs the same default-parameter initialization as the preceding routine; it is a duplicate copy of the same code with identical behaviour.

name: initialize_channel_block_from_arguments
description: Writes the default parameter words of a channel block at the pointer argument, using the two register arguments as its initial position values and linking the block to the supplied table.

name: advance_timer_step_reload
description: Subtracts a step from a timer word and, while the result stays negative, calls a subroutine and reloads the timer by twelve.

name: run_five_subroutines
description: Calls five subroutines in sequence with no other work of its own.

name: run_two_subroutines
description: Calls two subroutines in sequence with no other work of its own.

name: step_command_stream_on_countdown
description: Counts down a delay in a channel block and, when it expires, reads command bytes from a stream: a non-negative byte sets the note and duration fields and calls a subroutine, while a negative byte is dispatched through a jump table.

name: start_channel_note_envelope
description: Clears a channel link when it points at the current entry, and when a note value is nonzero links the next stored entry, resets the envelope fields and derives the attack step from the stored durations.

name: update_channel_volume_and_period
description: Advances an active channel each tick: it steps a modulation value that reverses direction, looks up a table entry from the combined pitch to set the period, scales the volume by a global level, and then takes the next data word or reuses the current one.

name: write_marker_record_or_stop
description: Decrements a countdown; while it stays non-negative it writes a two-byte marker constant, the argument and a pointer into the output list and advances the list, otherwise it clears the active flag and unlinks the channel.

name: validate_marker_and_advance_record
description: Checks the marker word at the output pointer; if it does not match the expected constant it deactivates the channel, otherwise it counts down the stored counter and advances the record pointer when that counter reaches zero.

name: advance_output_record_pointer
description: Moves the output pointer and its counter forward by eight units with no other work.

name: deactivate_channel_and_unlink
description: Clears the channel's active byte and, when it is linked to a waiting entry, calls a routine and clears that link.

name: set_flag_from_zero_condition
description: Stores minus one in a flag byte when the preceding comparison did not set the zero condition, and zero otherwise.

name: store_argument_into_record_word
description: Writes the argument word into a fixed word field of the record.

name: save_registers_and_toggle_flag
description: Copies the processor data and address registers into fixed memory cells, calls two subroutines, sets, inverts or clears a flag byte depending on two conditions, and decrements a counter.

key: railroad tycoon (1990)(microprose)[cr image][h reaktor]/Railroad Tycoon (1990)(MicroProse)[cr Image][h Reaktor].adf:C/binddrivers:0:0000
name: parse_startup_arguments_and_run
description: Allocates a startup record, takes the arguments from the command line or from the Workbench startup message, parses quoted and escaped words into a list, runs the main routine, then frees the record and closes the libraries, returning 20 when the allocation fails.

key: railroad tycoon (1990)(microprose)[cr image][h reaktor]/Railroad Tycoon (1990)(MicroProse)[cr Image][h Reaktor].adf:C/binddrivers:2:0000
name: bind_expansion_drivers
description: Opens the expansion and icon libraries and allocates a 260-byte buffer, then walks a list of expansion entries, matching each product name against a stored table and running a per-entry routine with the matched entry temporarily guarded, before releasing the buffers and libraries.

key: railroad tycoon (1990)(microprose)[cr image][h reaktor]/Railroad Tycoon (1990)(MicroProse)[cr Image][h Reaktor].adf:C/binddrivers:2:01E6
name: find_resident_module_tag
description: Scans a block of memory from the start address for a header that carries a fixed marker word and a pointer back to itself, returning that header or null when none is found within the range.

key: railroad tycoon (1990)(microprose)[cr image][h reaktor]/Railroad Tycoon (1990)(MicroProse)[cr Image][h Reaktor].adf:C/binddrivers:2:021C
name: combine_pipe_separated_segments
description: Walks a string split at vertical-bar characters, passing each segment to a combining routine and accumulating the results, and returns the total.

key: railroad tycoon (1990)(microprose)[cr image][h reaktor]/Railroad Tycoon (1990)(MicroProse)[cr Image][h Reaktor].adf:C/binddrivers:2:0268
name: parse_slash_separated_path_part
description: Finds the next slash-separated part of a path, performs a lookup on the part before it, and combines the result with the lookup of the remaining path, returning zero when a lookup fails.

key: railroad tycoon (1990)(microprose)[cr image][h reaktor]/Railroad Tycoon (1990)(MicroProse)[cr Image][h Reaktor].adf:C/binddrivers:2:02F8
name: prepend_flagged_nodes_to_list
description: Walks the nodes returned by a search routine and, for each node whose flag bit one is set and that is not already in the list, links it at the head by storing the previous head in its link field, then returns the new head.

key: railroad tycoon (1990)(microprose)[cr image][h reaktor]/Railroad Tycoon (1990)(MicroProse)[cr Image][h Reaktor].adf:C/binddrivers:2:034A
name: search_link_chain_for_node
description: Follows the link stored at offset 48 from each node in turn, returning the pointer with a flag set to one when the target node is reached and zero when the chain ends.

key: railroad tycoon (1990)(microprose)[cr image][h reaktor]/Railroad Tycoon (1990)(MicroProse)[cr Image][h Reaktor].adf:C/binddrivers:2:0368
name: find_non_digit_within_length
description: Scans up to the given number of characters and returns one as soon as a non-digit is found, and zero when every checked character is a digit; a zero length returns one.

key: railroad tycoon (1990)(microprose)[cr image][h reaktor]/Railroad Tycoon (1990)(MicroProse)[cr Image][h Reaktor].adf:C/binddrivers:2:0396
name: parse_decimal_integer
description: Reads decimal digit characters from a string until a non-digit or the terminator, accumulating them into an integer that it returns.

key: railroad tycoon (1990)(microprose)[cr image][h reaktor]/Railroad Tycoon (1990)(MicroProse)[cr Image][h Reaktor].adf:C/binddrivers:2:03C6
name: return_result_if_within_bound
description: Calls a lookup with its first two arguments and returns the result, or zero when that result exceeds the first argument plus the third argument.

key: railroad tycoon (1990)(microprose)[cr image][h reaktor]/Railroad Tycoon (1990)(MicroProse)[cr Image][h Reaktor].adf:C/binddrivers:4:0006
name: compare_two_strings
description: Compares two zero-terminated byte strings character by character, returning minus one at the first difference where the first character is smaller and one where it is larger, and zero when both strings end together.

key: railroad tycoon (1990)(microprose)[cr image][h reaktor]/Railroad Tycoon (1990)(MicroProse)[cr Image][h Reaktor].adf:C/binddrivers:4:0020
name: measure_c_string_length
description: Counts the characters of a zero-terminated string and returns that length.

key: railroad tycoon (1990)(microprose)[cr image][h reaktor]/Railroad Tycoon (1990)(MicroProse)[cr Image][h Reaktor].adf:C/binddrivers:4:0024
name: measure_c_string_length
description: Counts the characters of a zero-terminated string and returns that length.

key: railroad tycoon (1990)(microprose)[cr image][h reaktor]/Railroad Tycoon (1990)(MicroProse)[cr Image][h Reaktor].adf:C/binddrivers:4:0030
name: find_character_in_string
description: Returns a pointer to the first occurrence of the given character in a zero-terminated string, or null when the character is absent.

key: railroad tycoon (1990)(microprose)[cr image][h reaktor]/Railroad Tycoon (1990)(MicroProse)[cr Image][h Reaktor].adf:C/binddrivers:4:004C
name: copy_c_string
description: Copies the source string byte by byte into the destination, including the terminating zero byte.

key: railroad tycoon (1990)(microprose)[cr image][h reaktor]/Railroad Tycoon (1990)(MicroProse)[cr Image][h Reaktor].adf:C/binddrivers:4:0058
name: compute_bounded_offset
description: Computes an offset from the argument and two values returned by lookups, returning that offset when the second lookup value does not exceed the first and a further check passes, and zero otherwise.

key: railroad tycoon (1990)(microprose)[cr image][h reaktor]/Railroad Tycoon (1990)(MicroProse)[cr Image][h Reaktor].adf:C/type:0:0136
name: copy_sixteen_longs_then_call
description: When the destination pointer is non-null, copies sixteen 32-bit words from a fixed block in the base record into it, then calls a jump-vector routine.

key: railroad tycoon (1990)(microprose)[cr image][h reaktor]/Railroad Tycoon (1990)(MicroProse)[cr Image][h Reaktor].adf:C/path:0:0000
name: build_handler_block_from_template
description: Builds a block sized from the largest of several table entries, fills its header words with a tagged sequence, records the handler address and copies a sixteen-word template into it, returning minus one when the allocation fails.

key: railroad tycoon (1990)(microprose)[cr image][h reaktor]/Railroad Tycoon (1990)(MicroProse)[cr Image][h Reaktor].adf:C/path:0:0136
name: copy_sixteen_longs_then_call
